hotspots.title: US Midterm Election Rout & MAGA Internal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: Fallout from the Republican defeat in the US midterm elections continues to dominate coverage, with internal MAGA factions trading blame over administration policy and the ongoing war in Iran. Prominent figures like Vice President JD Vance, Representative Thomas Massie, and European allies are publicly distancing themselves or calling for personnel changes, including the impeachment of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
hotspots.affect: Commands white-hot investment as the movement processes a major electoral defeat, sparking open infighting and existential panic over leadership strategy.

hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: Tensions surrounding Poland's Constitutional Tribunal escalated significantly after President Karol Nawrocki entered the building under State Protection Service escort during a standoff with law enforcement. PiS Chairman Jarosław Kaczyński announced a specialized parliamentary team to investigate what he termed an unconstitutional coup d'état, warning that political opponents could face life imprisonment.
hotspots.affect: Extremely charged due to dramatic legal escalation, threats of criminal prosecution against government officials, and physical security confrontations at state institutions.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Following his presidential election loss, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro travelled to the United States to address a CPAC gala at Mar-a-Lago, declaring he would take political secrets 'to the grave.' The story has intensified amid allegations of fast-tracked Italian citizenship for the family and growing scrutiny from Brazilian judicial authorities.
hotspots.affect: Driven by intense narrative investment in exile political drama, accusations of legal persecution, and ongoing battles over electoral legitimacy.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei Madrid Visit & Vox Alliance
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei stirred intense media reaction during his visit to Madrid by delivering a plenary speech at the Ibero-American Summit that equated socialism with fascism. His cold greeting with Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez stood in stark contrast to his high-profile public alignment with Vox leader Santiago Abascal.
hotspots.affect: Captures high affective charge through intentional diplomatic provocation, explosive ideological framing, and visible transnational right-wing movement solidarity.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Rassemblement National leaders Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella dominated French right-wing news as Bardella promoted his new book amid journalist walkouts and renewed scrutiny over past controversial remarks. Concurrently, the party is advancing aggressive constitutional reform proposals while constructing its intelligence and defense platform for 2027.
hotspots.affect: Commands attention through ongoing friction between party leadership and mainstream media alongside hyper-focused preparations for executive power.
